title: Woman and Girl at Cabin Doorway, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century square snapshot showing a woman standing inside the open doorway of a small white timber cottage or cabin, accompanied by a young girl standing on the wooden porch steps holding a small bundle or doll. Flowering shrubbery lines the foundation of the steps, and the rear section of a vintage automobile is visible on the far right edge of the frame.
